posts.headline:
Every sport.
One stage.
posts.body: Cricket, badminton, tennis, padel, table tennis and pickleball. One app for matchday.
posts.alt: SportStage: Every sport. One stage. Cricket and racquet-sport equipment on a dark court.

posts.headline:
Every ball.
A new story.
posts.body: Score it ball by ball. Share it the moment it ends.
posts.alt: A cricket bat and red ball on an evening pitch. Every ball. A new story. Cricket scoring and match sharing on SportStage.

posts.headline:
Own the rally.
Keep the score.
posts.body: Tap a score card to record the rally. The app tracks serve and games.
posts.alt: A badminton shuttlecock and racket on a court. Own the rally. Keep the score.

posts.headline:
Which sport
today?
posts.body: Choose a sport, then review the players and rules.
posts.alt: The SportStage Start a match screen, asking Which sport today?, with photo tiles for six sports.

posts.headline:
Big matchday.
Clear next task.
posts.body: Registrations, fixture plan, bracket and sponsors, in one organiser workspace.
posts.alt: SportStage organiser workspace: registrations, fixture plan, winning bracket and sponsors in one tournament workflow.

posts.category: PUT YOUR PARTNERS IN THE PICTURE
posts.headline:
Their support.
Your stage.
posts.body: Add sponsors with a logo, label and website to your tournament.
posts.alt: SportStage tournament sponsors: add a name, logo and sponsor label. An illustrative title-sponsor card is shown.

posts.headline:
Keep your crew
in the game.
posts.body: Share the match link. Your crew can follow every point.
posts.alt: Illustrative racket-sport score board: Side A serving at 18, Side B receiving at 17. Keep your crew in the game.

posts.headline:
Back to
your game.
posts.body: A little cricket. A little court time. All in one place.
posts.alt: The SportStage home screen, Back to your game, with photo tiles for cricket, badminton, tennis, padel, table tennis and pickleball.

posts.headline:
See the patterns.
Shape your game.
posts.body: Add details to each point. See where you finish, how you serve and when momentum swings.
posts.alt: An illustrative SportStage Performance Lab chart: where you finish, with bars for winners, net kills, drops and errors forced.

posts.headline:
The road to
the title.
posts.body: Plan groups, seed qualifiers and watch the bracket advance with every result.
posts.alt: An illustrative SportStage knockout bracket, with two semi-finals leading to a champion slot. The road to the title.

posts.category: A LITTLE LOVE FOR THE SCOREKEEPERS
posts.headline:
They play.
You keep count.
posts.body: Wrong tap? Undo it, and keep the match moving.
posts.alt: A cricket bat and ball on a pitch. They play. You keep count. A SportStage post for scorekeepers.

posts.headline:
Make your next
match count.
posts.body: Meet SportStage. Every sport. One stage.
posts.alt: SportStage S logo with the headline Make your next match count.

carousel.headline:
Less matchday
guesswork.
carousel.body: Your first racket match on SportStage, step by step.

carousel.headline:
Which sport
today?
carousel.body: Tap Start a match and choose your sport.

carousel.headline:
Who’s playing?
Know the format.
carousel.body: Pick the players and first server, then review the match rules.

carousel.headline:
Ready when
you are.
carousel.body: Tap Start match, then tap a score card to record each rally.

carousel.headline:
Wrong tap?
Undo it.
carousel.body: Tap Undo to remove the latest rally from the score.

carousel.headline:
Your next match.
Your stage.
carousel.body: Save the playbook. Share it with your scorekeeper.
